from pathlib import Path
import re
root=Path('school')
lessons=sorted((root/'src/content/lessons').glob('*.md'))
assert len(lessons)==7
slugs=[]
for i,p in enumerate(lessons,1):
    text=p.read_text()
    parts=text.split('---',2)
    assert len(parts)==3 and parts[0]=='\n' or text.startswith('---\n')
    header=text.split('---',2)[1]
    for key in ('title','slug','description','order','quiz','agentOnly','agentInstructions'):
        assert re.search(r'^'+key+r':',header,re.M),(p,key)
    assert f'order: {i}\n' in header
    assert 'quiz: false\n' in header and 'agentOnly: true\n' in header
    assert 'agentInstructions: |\n' in header
    slug=re.search(r'^slug: (.+)$',header,re.M).group(1)
    assert re.fullmatch(r'[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*',slug)
    slugs.append(slug)
    assert len(parts[2].strip())>1000
    assert text.count('```')%2==0
    for path in re.findall(r'(?:\{origin\})?/(sources|activities)/([^\s)；，]+)',text):
        file=root/'public'/path[0]/path[1].rstrip('。')
        assert file.is_file(),(p,file)
    print(f'{p.name}: frontmatter, local references, code fences checked')
assert len(set(slugs))==7
for file in (root/'public/sources/material-1').iterdir():
    original=Path('materials/material-1')/file.name
    assert original.read_bytes()==file.read_bytes(),file
    print(f'{file.name}: source copy byte-identical')
allowed=[]
for p in root.rglob('*'):
    if p.is_file():
        rel=p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        assert rel=='COURSE.md' or re.fullmatch(r'src/content/lessons/[^/]+\.md',rel) or rel.startswith('public/sources/') or rel.startswith('public/activities/'),rel
        allowed.append(rel)
print(f'Output contains {len(allowed)} files, all in permitted curriculum paths.')
PY

        n+=1
